comments.body:
Hi, I have a ZKB student account and I'm happy with it. Can't answer questions about UBS. 

- I don't know about the UBS benefits, but I'm using the stuCard benefits quite often. Check the list and see which one you might use more.

- I have a ZVV Abo because weekend evenings are not enough for me as I commute to eth with the train. Maybe if you live close to eth or cycle there. I've used it a couple of times before getting the GA night to visit friends in other ZVV zones. However, I can really recommend the GA night (free as of 7pm in whole Switzerland, 99 CHF per year).

- Yes the asvz discount is usable on anything that costs something (there might be some exceptions that I don't know). I've used it for rowing and climbing courses. Maybe once a year. That depends on how many courses you take. There are many opportunities.

Hope that helps!
comments.author: creative_empathy
